notes.title: The game is available in English now
notes.content:
English language has been added
But in terms of skills, the original text was retained because the skill name is not closely related to its effect, and it is difficult for the translated skill name to match the original meaning.
Don't worry, your own skills have been explained in the description section, and the effects of enemy skills are also easy to understand, so it won't affect gameplay.

notes.content: 修复了能提前进入天界的问题
